na.paging: Current generic adapter is GET-only; upstream paging is not a connector capability.

local-directory.many: The local-directory fixture exercises bounded filesystem scanning in its dedicated contract tests.
local-directory.few: The local-directory fixture exercises bounded filesystem scanning in its dedicated contract tests.
local-directory.empty: The local-directory fixture exercises bounded filesystem scanning in its dedicated contract tests.
local-directory.query-encoding: Catalogues are fetched independently of a query; filtering is local.
local-directory.limits: The local-directory fixture exercises bounded filesystem limits in its dedicated contract tests.
local-directory.invalid-mixed: Filesystem rows are not mixed JSON payloads.
local-directory.duplicates: Filesystem identity duplication is covered by the local scanner contract.
local-directory.optional-fields: Filesystem metadata is covered by the local scanner contract.
local-directory.failures: Filesystem error mapping is covered by the local scanner contract.
local-directory.credentials: Temporary local fixtures have no remote credential lane.
local-directory.cache: The local adapter has no source response cache.
local-directory.selection: Selection belongs to federation, not a local scanner.
